mandatory_invariants: The cohort service allocation must reconcile to RegionOutcome.served and RegionOutcome.unmet from the shared resource ledger.
Changing the financial discount rate cannot change physical stock, service, or liability quantities.
Splitting a cohort into identical subcohorts cannot change region-year aggregate service quantities.
Reassigning a liability changes cohort incidence but cannot change the physical or financial total.
A cohort inheritance record references outstanding financial liability IDs and cannot duplicate their amounts.
Every future cohort outside the simulation horizon has an inheritance snapshot from the preceding closing-year boundary.
Unassigned obligations remain visible with an explicit reason.
claim_ceiling: Population counts and cohort sizes are synthetic scenario assumptions, not observed demographics.
The pump condition index and maintenance obligation are declared synthetic inputs, not calibrated engineering models.
The ZAR amount is illustrative synthetic nominal debt in a 2026 price base, not a current fiscal estimate.
The benchmark does not determine a correct discount rate, utility function, or universal fairness weighting.
No empirical intergenerational welfare or SOTA superiority claim is made.
